plan: Drive: from Salmon Arm, about 129 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy NE), Hwy 1 (50 St NE), Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy), North Fork FSR.
Park: 51.56408, -118.90741, where the truck road ends (Seymour River FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 1.2 km to the start. Ride: the Cp 706 stretch, 3.3 km one way. About 66 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
